description: This file is a Java Spring Boot REST controller for managing notes. It exposes CRUD endpoints for notes, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes. The endpoints leverage annotations for request mappings, validation, and API documentation.

classes.name: NoteController
classes.description: REST controller managing CRUD operations for notes, exposing endpoints at '/api/notes'.

methods.name: listNotes
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes as NoteResponse objects.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note based on the provided NoteRequest.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with new data from NoteRequest.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note identified by ID.
